rules.floored: y = sqrt(max(Delta, 0)); SE = se / (2 sqrt(max(Delta, se))): the delta method, with the derivative taken at Delta = se when Delta < se (then SE = sqrt(se)/2)
rules.parametric: y as above; SE = SD of sqrt(max(X, 0)) for X ~ N(max(Delta, 0), se^2) (numerical)
rules.delta_scale: REML on Delta (meta.json's method), then the square root of the mean, of the HKSJ bounds and of the prediction bounds, each truncated at 0
rules.unweighted: plain mean of the per-pair sqrt(Delta) with a t interval over pairs
rules.naive_positive: the plain delta method se / (2 sqrt(Delta)) on the pairs with Delta > 0 only
